correctness.rationale: First-edge counts and conditional independence follow from uniform remaining-edge priorities; the exact recurrence and first-order ODE were recomputed; its analytic closed solution and coefficient form yield the stated absolutely convergent tail and strict alternating-series bound. All-size proof does not rely on finite checks. Two packaged exact-rational programs replayed from their own full paths.

originality.rationale: The newly proved exact first-edge reduction, Dawson special-function density and parity-alternating superfactorial correction are not equivalent to the accessible prior results, which treat other lattice geometries or general techniques. Primary full-text comparison with Pippenger 1989 and Evans–Nord 1992 is blocked; that historical priority risk is explicitly retained. Negative search alone is not treated as proof of uniqueness.
residual_risks: The Pippenger (1989) and Evans–Nord (1992) complete primary texts were not accessible, leaving possible prior exact specializations unadjudicated.
No claim of absolute novelty, uniqueness of scientific priority or independent review is made; database searches can miss alternate terminology.

value.rationale: A natural irreversible dimer jamming observable on periodically leaf-decorated rings receives an exact finite-size solution, new special-function density, and parity-dependent superfactorially vanishing correction. These distinguish finite cyclic effects from ordinary boundary effects and provide a justified exact benchmark; not merely a renaming of one-dimensional dimer adsorption.
